say:2:1210801001:0.text: Blasted fishscales! The ship we worked so hard to get...
say:2:1210801001:0.source_cn: 可恶，好不容易得到的船……

say:4:1210801002:1.text: There's a big scratch on the right side. Sinbad, how's it looking on your end?
say:4:1210801002:1.source_cn: 右侧面有很大的擦痕。辛巴达，你那边呢？

say:6:1210801003:1.text: There are a few big holes on the lower side of the keel and the hull, but luckily the mast is still intact.
say:6:1210801003:1.source_cn: 在龙骨侧下方和船腹都有大洞，还好桅杆没断。

say:7:1210801004:1.text: If we don't want this ship to be out of commission, we need to repair it as soon as possible.
say:7:1210801004:1.source_cn: 如果不想让这艘船退休，现在就去找点东西修一修。

say:8:1210801005:1.text: I see some beech trees over there, those would work well.
say:8:1210801005:1.source_cn: 这岛上应该有榉心木，我和你们一起去找找吧。

choice_prompt:9:1210801005.text: I see some beech trees over there, those would work well.
choice_prompt:9:1210801005.source_cn: 这岛上应该有榉心木，我和你们一起去找找吧。

say:10:1210801006:1.text: I'll stay here and guard these Water Wights and... Nara.
say:10:1210801006:1.source_cn: 我留在这里看守这些水鬼。还有……奈拉。

say:11:1210801007:1.text: I'll go with you! I'm pretty good with my hands.
say:11:1210801007:1.source_cn: 我和你们去，修船这事我熟。

choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 找材料的事就交给我吧

choice:9:1:2.text: What about the others on the ship?
choice:9:1:2.male: What about the others on the ship?
choice:9:1:2.female: What about the others on the ship?

say:0:1210802001:0.text: Luckily, there are plenty of trees on this island. We'll be able to get plenty of materials.
say:0:1210802001:0.source_cn: 幸好这座岛上有很多树，应该能找到合适的材料。

say:1:1210803002:0.text: The wood is a little too loose, it's not suitable for ship repairs. We need to look for some older trees.
say:1:1210803002:0.source_cn: 木质太疏松了，不适合作为修船木材。得找树龄大的。

say:0:1210804001:0.text: The trees here look great, they must have been here for a very long time.
say:0:1210804001:0.source_cn: 这里的树看起来好多了，年头很足。

say:0:1210805001:0.text: Look at this one! It's so sturdy, it'll be perfect for the ship!
say:0:1210805001:0.source_cn: 快看，这么粗壮的老树，用来修船再好不过！

say:1:1210805002:0.text: It's rare to see a tree this big... Sorry, Mr. Tree!
say:1:1210805002:0.source_cn: 能长到这个年头的树不容易……树先生，抱歉啦！

say:0:1210808001:0.text: This island is truly remarkable, with its slumbering tree and a fairy guarding treasure...
say:0:1210808001:0.source_cn: 这个岛真是不可思议，竟然有沉睡的大树，还有守护宝藏的妖精……

say:1:1210808002:0.text: Minstrels in the future will sing songs about our mighty adventure here!
say:1:1210808002:0.source_cn: 简直像吟游诗人唱过的传说故事一样！

say:2:1210808003:0.text: It's been a while since I've had an adventure like this.
say:2:1210808003:0.source_cn: 真是久违的冒险啊……哈哈……

say:1:1210810001:0.text: Sonja, who are these people? They look kind of scary...
say:1:1210810001:0.source_cn: 索尼娅姐姐，这、这些是什么人啊……

say:4:1210810002:0.text: Don't worry, these are my friends.

say:5:1210810003:0.text: Friends... wasn't I your only friend?
say:5:1210810003:0.source_cn: 朋友……姐姐的朋友，不是只有我一个吗？

choice_prompt:6:1210810003.text: Friends... wasn't I your only friend?
choice_prompt:6:1210810003.source_cn: 朋友……姐姐的朋友，不是只有我一个吗？

say:7:1210810004:1.text: Nara lost her memories... It's like she's back in our childhood, when it was just the two of us.
say:7:1210810004:1.source_cn: 奈拉失忆了……她好像回到了当年和我相依为命的童年。
say:7:1210810004:1.male: Nara lost her memories... It's like she's back in our childhood, when it was just the two of us.
say:7:1210810004:1.female: Nara lost her memories... It's like she's back in our childhood, when it was just the two of us.

say:8:1210810006:0.text: Sonja, I can't believe you're falling for this. Even the children in Rustport wouldn't believe this shoddy acting.
say:8:1210810006:0.source_cn: 索尼娅，你不会真上当了吧？这种戏码，锈锚港的混混都演腻了。

say:9:1210810007:0.text: Do you think we're in some drama performance right now?! There's no way she lost her memories that easily. What a joke!
say:9:1210810007:0.source_cn: 前一秒还满肚子坏水，被打一棍子昏过去，醒过来就变成好人...

say:10:1210810008:1.text: To be honest, I'm as surprised as you are.
say:10:1210810008:1.source_cn: 坦白说，我的惊讶不比你们少。

say:11:1210810009:1.text: But I've double-checked. Nara really has forgotten everything from the past few years.
say:11:1210810009:1.source_cn: 但我已经确认过了，奈拉的确忘记了很多事。

say:12:1210810010:1.text: Her memories have returned to back then... before <style="highlight">we faced that shipwreck</style>.
say:12:1210810010:1.source_cn: 她的记忆回到了小时候……回到了<style=highl...

say:13:1210810011:1.text: If she's faking it just to wait for us to drop our guards... the consequences would be disastrous.
say:13:1210810011:1.source_cn: 万一她是装的，等我们松懈了给我们一刀，后果不堪设想。

say:14:1210810012:1.text: You saw what she was like earlier. Do you think someone with that temperament would be able to act like this?
say:14:1210810012:1.source_cn: 你觉得，以她的逻辑和智商，她有演员的素养？

say:15:1210810013:1.text: This isn't even remotely funny, Sonja.
say:15:1210810013:1.source_cn: 哈！这个笑话一点也不好笑。

say:16:1210810014:1.text: Is it... you secretly hoping she really did lose her memory?
say:16:1210810014:1.source_cn: 其实……是你心里更希望她失忆了吧。

say:18:1210810016:1.text: Fine. I understand how you feel, she's your family after all. Just make sure to keep an eye on her, and don't let her distract us from finding that treasure.
say:18:1210810016:1.source_cn: 那就把她看好，别影响了我们寻宝。

say:20:1210810017:0.text: Treasure? Is there really treasure?! That sounds super fun!
say:20:1210810017:0.source_cn: 寻宝？！有宝贝吗？！奈拉喜欢宝贝！

say:21:1210810018:0.text: Hey, hey, no need to suddenly get so in my face!
say:21:1210810018:0.source_cn: 喂喂喂，说话就说话，别突然凑过来！

say:22:1210810019:1.text: Why not? You're my sister's friends, and she's super smart. Sonja's friends would never hit me or steal my bread!
say:22:1210810019:1.source_cn: 为什么不可以？你们是姐姐的朋友，不会打我，也不会抢我的面包。

say:23:1210810020:1.text: And I have a good feeling about you guys! You guys seem really nice!
say:23:1210810020:1.source_cn: 嘻嘻，你们是好人！我喜欢好人！

say:24:1210810021:0.text: *Sigh* For some reason I feel like now she'll be more difficult to deal with than before...
say:24:1210810021:0.source_cn: 啧……失忆了比之前还难缠。

say:27:1210810022:0.text: What's this treasure hunt? I thought you went off to find wood.
say:27:1210810022:0.source_cn: 寻宝是怎么回事？你们不是去找木材了吗？

narration:28:1210810023:0.text: You explain the whole story, from Tasi and Ulmus to the treasure on this island.
narration:28:1210810023:0.source_cn: 把遇到塔西和奥曼斯，岛上有宝藏的事告诉了索尼娅……

say:29:1210810024:1.text: A fairy guardian, a treant, and even treasure... How are you sure that it's not a trap?
say:29:1210810024:1.source_cn: 蝴蝶妖精，树人，宝藏……？确定不是陷阱？

say:30:1210810025:1.text: If you hadn't brought back wood and Magister Merlin wasn't here, I would've sworn you're under some spell.
say:30:1210810025:1.source_cn: 如果不是你们把木材带回来了，而且还有梅林在，我真怀疑你...
say:30:1210810025:1.male: If you hadn't brought back wood and Magister Merlin wasn't here, I would've sworn you're under some spell.
say:30:1210810025:1.female: If you hadn't brought back wood and Magister Merlin wasn't here, I would've sworn you're under some spell.

choice_prompt:31:1210810025.text: If you hadn't brought back wood and Magister Merlin wasn't here, I would've sworn you're under some spell.
choice_prompt:31:1210810025.source_cn: 如果不是你们把木材带回来了，而且还有梅林在，我真怀疑你们是不是中了什么幻术。
choice_prompt:31:1210810025.male: If you hadn't brought back wood and Magister Merlin wasn't here, I would've sworn you're under some spell.
choice_prompt:31:1210810025.female: If you hadn't brought back wood and Magister Merlin wasn't here, I would've sworn you're under some spell.

say:32:1210810026:1.text: Though they look quite old, they seem to be in good shape. These are usable.
say:32:1210810026:1.source_cn: 虽然有年头了，但保存得很好。可以用。
say:32:1210810026:1.male: Though they look quite old, they seem to be in good shape. These are usable.
say:32:1210810026:1.female: Though they look quite old, they seem to be in good shape. These are usable.

say:33:1210810028:0.text: Let's give these materials to the Wights and have them fix the ship.
say:33:1210810028:0.source_cn: 把这些材料分派给水鬼帮的那些家伙，让他们修船吧。

say:34:1210810029:1.text: Sonja, Sonja! I wanna go find the treasure!

say:35:1210810030:0.text: A treasure guarded by a fairy sounds so epic! I wanna be an adventurer, let's go!
say:35:1210810030:0.source_cn: 是小妖精守护的，祝福冒险家的宝藏啊！我想去找宝藏！！！

say:36:1210810031:0.text: Easy now. The ship will be fixed soon and then we can head back to the city.
say:36:1210810031:0.source_cn: ……再忍耐一下，船修好后我们就回城。

say:38:1210810032:0.text: Honestly, Sonja, aren't you a bit too calm about this? This is the treasure of the god of the waves. The god of the waves! Right here on this island!
say:38:1210810032:0.source_cn: 我说，索尼娅，你也太冷静了吧？那可是风浪与漂泊之神的宝...

say:39:1210810033:0.text: Don't tell me you've never heard that <style="highlight">folk song</style>, even the kids in Rustport know of it.
say:39:1210810033:0.source_cn: 难道你没听过<style=highlight>那首民谣...

say:40:1210810034:1.text: Beneath the vortex where four waterfalls meet, gleams the treasure of the divine. Riding waves and wind, so fine, offering gifts from the sea's deep night.
say:40:1210810034:1.source_cn: 四瀑汇流漩涡下，神明宝藏闪光芒，乘风破浪屏息行，海洋馈...

say:41:1210810035:1.text: ... If that's what you sound like reciting the song, I never want to hear you try to actually sing it.

say:42:1210810036:1.text: Come on! I know I don't have the greatest voice, but it couldn't have been that bad!
say:42:1210810036:1.source_cn: 别见怪，我找不着调，怕吓着你们。

say:45:1210810037:1.text: I never thought I'd see someone like Sinbad embarrassed. He's usually so cool...
say:45:1210810037:1.source_cn: 辛巴达居然也有不好意思的时候，好少见。

say:46:1210810038:1.text: I do know this song. One can't grow up in Rustport without hearing it.
say:46:1210810038:1.source_cn: 我知道这首歌，是锈锚港口口相传的寻宝歌谣。

say:47:1210810039:1.text: But what worries me is, according to that fairy, we're stuck here unless we find the treasure?
say:47:1210810039:1.source_cn: 但我更关心的是，照那个妖精的意思，不去寻宝，我们无法离...

say:48:1210810040:1.text: That's what the girl said, and I believe her.
say:48:1210810040:1.source_cn: 她是这么说的，我觉得是真的。

say:49:1210810041:1.text: C'mon, live a little. The ship will take a while to be repaired, and there's nothing to do in the meantime. Why not explore the island? It'll be a bonus if we find some treasure.
say:49:1210810041:1.source_cn: 船一时半刻也修不好，不如去岛上转转，如果找到宝藏，也是...

say:50:1210810042:0.text: Ah... Fine. You there, come here. Watch over the Wights repairing the ship. Make sure they don't get up to no good.
say:50:1210810042:0.source_cn: 那就让船员修船。你们，看住水鬼帮的。让他们也派上用场。

say:61:1210810044:0.text: Yeah! Listen to Sonja's orders! If anyone runs away, I'll sew them into cute little cloth dolls!
say:61:1210810044:0.source_cn: 对，都听姐姐的话。要是有人跑了，我就把你们做成——布、...

say:62:1210810045:0.text: Y-yes, miss! We'll definitely stick to the plan!
say:62:1210810045:0.source_cn: 大、大姐头，你放心，我们一定乖乖听你的！

say:63:1210810046:0.text: How did the boss' sister suddenly become like this?
say:63:1210810046:0.source_cn: 唉……大姐头怎么突然变成这个样子了。

say:66:1210810047:0.text: Hehe, big sister! They're behaving so well. Shall we go? Let's go find the treasure!
say:66:1210810047:0.source_cn: 姐姐你瞧，他们都乖乖听话了。那，我们出发吧？去找小妖精...

choice:31:1:2.text: I wouldn't let that happen to him.
choice:31:1:2.male: I wouldn't let that happen to him.
choice:31:1:2.female: I wouldn't let that happen to him.

say:69:1210810005:1.text: This feels exactly like how it was during our childhood, when it was just the two of us.
say:69:1210810005:1.source_cn: 她和我相依为命的那段童年时光，就像现在这样。
say:69:1210810005:1.male: This feels exactly like how it was during our childhood, when it was just the two of us.
say:69:1210810005:1.female: This feels exactly like how it was during our childhood, when it was just the two of us.

say:0:1210811001:0.text: Nara smiling so cutely while saying she'll turn people into dolls is so creepy...
say:0:1210811001:0.source_cn: 奈拉笑眯眯地说要把人做成布娃娃，也太可怕了……

say:1:1210811002:0.text: Oh my! These little hamsters can talk? How adorable! Why don't you guys play with me?
say:1:1210811002:0.source_cn: 咦，这两个小老鼠会说话呢？可爱！做我的布娃娃吧！

say:4:1210813002:0.text: Well... in terms of what it says, Tasi wasn't lying. Only those who find the treasure can leave the island...
say:4:1210813002:0.source_cn: ……嗯……就内容来说，那位塔西小姐确实没有说谎。只有找...

say:5:1210813003:1.text: So if we can't find the treasure, we're stuck here forever?
say:5:1210813003:1.source_cn: 如果找不到宝藏，就会被永远困在这里？

say:6:1210813004:0.text: The person who wrote this note seemed pretty doubtful of themselves, but yes, that's what they said.
say:6:1210813004:0.source_cn: 写这份笔记的人好像陷入了自我怀疑，反正他是这么说的。

say:7:1210813005:0.text: What does it say about the <style="highlight">inscription in the center of the island</style>?
say:7:1210813005:0.source_cn: 笔记说的<style=highlight>岛中心的石碑...
say:7:1210813005:0.male: What does it say about the <style="highlight">inscription in the center of the island</style>?
say:7:1210813005:0.female: What does it say about the <style="highlight">inscription in the center of the island</style>?

choice_prompt:8:1210813005.text: What does it say about the <style="highlight">inscription in the center of the island</style>?
choice_prompt:8:1210813005.source_cn: 笔记说的<style=highlight>岛中心的石碑文字</style>是什么？
choice_prompt:8:1210813005.male: What does it say about the <style="highlight">inscription in the center of the island</style>?
choice_prompt:8:1210813005.female: What does it say about the <style="highlight">inscription in the center of the island</style>?

say:11:1210813006:0.text: Whatever it is, we have a new target. The stone tablet in the center of the island!
say:11:1210813006:0.source_cn: 不管是什么，总之我们有了新的目标——岛中心的石碑！
say:11:1210813006:0.male: Whatever it is, we have a new target. The stone tablet in the center of the island!
say:11:1210813006:0.female: Whatever it is, we have a new target. The stone tablet in the center of the island!

say:12:1210813008:0.text: Didn't the owner of the note give us directions? Let's go find this <style="highlight">stone tablet in the center of the island</style>.
say:12:1210813008:0.source_cn: 笔记的主人不是给我们指了路吗？走，去<style=hi...

say:19:1210813010:1.text: Nara and Sinbad are completely immersed in their roles as treasure-seeking adventurers.
say:19:1210813010:1.source_cn: 奈拉小姐和辛巴达看起来完全代入寻宝的冒险家角色了……

say:22:1210813011:1.text: Respected adventurers, Sir Chippy will pave the way for your adventure!
say:22:1210813011:1.source_cn: 尊敬的冒险家们，骑士满满，为你们的冒险之旅开路！

say:23:1210813012:1.text: Ah, even Chippy's joined in now...

say:26:1210813013:1.text: Well, this note is the only clue we've got. Let's assume it's genuine and follow it.
say:26:1210813013:1.source_cn: 前进吧，暂时就当这份笔记是善意的。

choice:8:0:1.text: I don't know. Let's go check.
choice:8:0:1.male: I don't know. Let's go check.
choice:8:0:1.female: I don't know. Let's go check.

say:28:1210813007:0.text: Yes, I agree. It must be a clue about the treasure.
say:28:1210813007:0.source_cn: 应该是提示我们找到宝藏的线索。
say:28:1210813007:0.male: Yes, I agree. It must be a clue about the treasure.
say:28:1210813007:0.female: Yes, I agree. It must be a clue about the treasure.

say:0:1210814001:0.text: Beneath the vortex where four waterfalls meet, gleams the treasure of the divine.
say:0:1210814001:0.source_cn: 四瀑汇流漩涡下，神明宝藏闪光芒。

say:1:1210814002:0.text: I wonder what the treasure will turn out to be.
say:1:1210814002:0.source_cn: 不知道到底是什么样的宝藏。

say:0:1210815001:0.text: There's another journal in the grass!
say:0:1210815001:0.male: There's another journal in the grass!
say:0:1210815001:0.female: There's another journal in the grass!

say:3:1210816001:1.text: This seems to be a continuation of the previous note. Looks like this Roswald guy spent a long time on this island...
say:3:1210816001:1.source_cn: 嗯……这是前面那份笔记的后续，看起来罗赛斯在岛上待了很久……

say:4:1210816002:1.text: He said he often goes to <style="highlight">where the divine treasure is bestowed</style>, to enjoy the breeze and sun.
say:4:1210816002:1.source_cn: 他说他经常去<style=highlight>神明赐予...

say:5:1210816003:1.text: The wind is blowing from ahead. Let's keep going, that should be where the divine treasure is bestowed!
say:5:1210816003:1.source_cn: 风是从前面吹过来的……这么说，我们继续朝着前方走，就是...

say:6:1210816004:0.text: Hmm, but on this map, there are a few wave circles over the location where "the divine treasure is bestowed". Chippy doesn't understand what that means.
say:6:1210816004:0.source_cn: 对，但神明赐予宝藏的地方还划了好多波浪圈，满满不太明白...

say:7:1210816005:0.text: Let me see... this must be the <style="highlight">great vortex</style>! The folk song says that to get to the treasure of the divine, you must go through the passage within the vortex!

choice_prompt:8:1210816005.text: Let me see... this must be the <style="highlight">great vortex</style>! The folk song says that to get to the treasure of the divine, you must go through the passage within the vortex!
choice_prompt:8:1210816005.source_cn: 让我看看……这一定是<style=highlight>大漩涡</style>。民谣里说，在神明守护的岛屿，漩涡就是通路。

say:9:1210816006:0.text: Remeber the song I told you about? It's mentioned in the lyrics! The song goes: across this island, secret currents intertwine, and the vortex is the highway through!
say:9:1210816006:0.source_cn: 海上有些神奇的漩涡，就是穿越的门径！
say:9:1210816006:0.male: Remeber the song I told you about? It's mentioned in the lyrics! The song goes: across this island, secret currents intertwine, and the vortex is the highway through!
say:9:1210816006:0.female: Remeber the song I told you about? It's mentioned in the lyrics! The song goes: across this island, secret currents intertwine, and the vortex is the highway through!

say:12:1210816009:0.text: If we really need to find the treasure to leave this island, let's follow the map and begin our search.
say:12:1210816009:0.source_cn: 如果真的要找到宝藏，才能离开这座岛的话。那就沿着地图找找吧。

say:13:1210816010:0.text: My goal is to just get out of here.
say:13:1210816010:0.source_cn: 我的目标只有离开这里。

say:15:1210816007:0.text: Would you like to hear my dulcet tones again?

say:1:1210818002:0.female: Let me do it, I'm great with languages.

say:12:1210819009:1.source_cn: 前面就是瀑布，试炼又在哪里？

say:27:1210807021:0.source_cn: 宝藏？！难道是“四瀑汇流漩涡下，神明宝藏闪光芒”的那个...

say:36:1210807030:1.text: I think there's a little miscommunication. We're not actually here for the treasure, we were attacked and got stranded on this island by accident.
